comments.text: Seeing how central rice and zebu beef are to the daily diet gives a genuine glimpse into Malagasy fuel for heavy labor. The street-side soup stalls look incredibly rugged yet deeply tied to the rhythm of daily town life. Nothing beats seeing authentic food prepared simply over open flame without any tourist fluff.
